profile.headline: Software Engineer, JSU Campus Recruiter, Intern Interviewer & Product Owner @State Farm 🔴⚪️| AWS Certified Cloud & AI Practitioner | Spring ’26 MBA Graduate @JSU 🐅 | Fall ’24 CS B.S Graduate @JSU 🐅 | NSBE Member
profile.summary: Hardworking, diligent, and focused, I have graduated Summa Cum Laude with a Masters Degree in Business Administration. I am passionate about technology and sports, having the tools necessary to contribute to its innovation and impact, particularly in sports, gaming monitor/desktops, app development or with an open interest in available Technology/IT Roles. I am interested in opportunities that are challenging, exciting, and rewarding, including Engineering Internships, PC Building Programs, and more. I graduated from Jackson State University with my MBA in May 2026, while being a Full-Time Software Engineer at State Farm and a part of the State Farms Recruiting Team for the Jackson State University Campus after receiving my Bachelors Degree in Computer Science December of 2024. I have also been selected as an Interviewer for State Farms 2027 Enterprise Technology (ET) Internship program. I most recently earned my AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner certification and AWS Certified AI Practitioner certification in July 2026, further building on my continuous passion for Technology.

positions.title: State Farm Software Engineer
positions.description: The experience will allow me to explore and utilize emerging technologies to help make a positive impact for State Farm and the customers. I will be utilizing both Frontend and Backend frameworks to solve real-world problems with amazing team members.
positions.insights: Software Deployment, Software Testing and +3 skills

positions.title: State Farm Software Engineering Summer & Fall Internship
positions.description:
The Enterprise Technology department is involved in exploring new and emerging technologies. This program offered hands-on work along with real-world research and development opportunities. State Farm continues to refine and expand the use of technology for employees, agents, and customers.
 I have been assigned to work on the AWS Migration team working on the Fire Secondary application. I was able to learn new languages such as html, css, and typescript/javascript for frontend development through Angular and for the backend, I utilized Java in the PDF Spring Boot API.
 I applied these new languages to create an application to be able to track errors that are coming from the queue in a more organized way by extracting the date, time, and payload that is returning from SQS in AWS.
I was then able to go through a Merge Request with my team to push my work to main.
After completing the Program, I was ranked 1st out of the 200 Interns and received an offer to return in the Fall Semester and a full-time job offer after the 2024 graduation.

positions.title: Coding Tutor
positions.description: These tutoring sessions provide an introduction to Java programming basics. It is targeted at students interested in learning Java fundamentals. The material aims to build a solid foundation for coding interviews and industry applications. In these tutoring sessions I will cover essential Java topics, including an introduction to IDEs, creating Java programs from scratch, understanding variables and data types, constructors, the main method, Java syntax, console usage, and performing various operations in print statements. Through hands-on practice and guided instruction, students will enhance their understanding of Java basics and improve their ability to explain coding logic.

positions.title: Childcare Worker
positions.description: The YMCA is a non-profit organization whose mission is to incorporate Christian principles into the various services, programs, and initiatives that are offered to the public. My responsibilities include helping preschoolers and elementary students develop trust and security, teaching early-literacy, helping with schoolwork, providing mentorship, and aiding in the younger students’ development of social skills while making friends. Offering Learning, Sports and Recreation, and other Programs, I am able to accomplish the aforementioned responsibilities through various mediums, allowing me to work with children in diverse ways throughout the day while making sure they have fun and follow directions. I am primarily assigned a class, provide aid with their after-school assignments, and allow the children to play a multitude of games such as tag, kickball, Simon Says, basketball, and more. We help children to realize their potential, prepare teens for college and career, provide opportunities for families to bond, and support people of all ages and backgrounds to be healthier in spirit, mind and body.

positions.title: Help Desk Technician
positions.description: You would learn a variety of technical and people skills if you worked as a help desk technician at The Solutions Team in Flowood, Mississippi. This would entail knowledge of how to diagnose and fix hardware and software problems, configure and manage computer systems, offer remote help, and document fixes. In order to effectively assist clients, listen to their problems, and provide clear and concise instructions or guidance to handle their technical needs, you would also develop good communication and customer service abilities. I worked as the Help Desk Technician, which was indeed a great experience in which everyday I learned something new from desktop problems to getting to know customers. I learned how important customers are and made sure they left satisfied.

organizations.name: National Honor Society for Collegiate Scholars
organizations.description: The NSCS (National Society Collegiate Scholars) recognizes the top students in each College and brings them together to give them more opportunities to make a difference in each others lives and to learn from one another through education, community service, and leadership. Being a part of the Society fills my heart with joy and brings to my attention that my hard work is being recognized by others.
